#!/bin/bash
# DIAWW.DEV - Pterodactyl Python Installation Script

apt update -y
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates python3 python3-pip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m USER_UPLOAD enabled. Skipping git clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m No GIT_ADDRESS specified. Creating default main.py..."

    exit 0
fi

GIT_TARGET="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [ ! -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ ! -z "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_TARGET="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"

    git clone ${GIT_TARGET} .
else

fi

if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;36m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installing requirements.txt dependencies..."
    pip install -U --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
fi

echo -e "\033[1;32m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installation complete!"
